ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the circuit shown, switch SW is closed at \( t = 0 \). Assuming zero initial conditions, the value of \( v_c(t) \) (in Volts) at \( t = 1 \) sec is ______.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached circuit, on the left side is a 10 V DC power supply, and the upper end of the power supply passes through switch SW; the switch is marked as closing at t=0. After the switch closes, the power supply is connected through a 3 Ω resistor to the upper node on the right side. This node is connected downward through a 2 Ω resistor to the bottom common node, and at the same time this node is also connected to the upper end of the capacitor on the right side; the capacitor is labeled 5/6 F, and the lower end of the capacitor is connected to the bottom common node. The polarity of the capacitor voltage v_c(t) is marked in the figure as positive at the top and negative at the bottom. Reasoning: The zero initial condition gives v_c(0)=0. For t≥0, the equivalent Thevenin voltage seen by the capacitor is the node voltage after voltage division by 3 Ω and 2 Ω: V_th=10×2/(3+2)=4 V. When finding the Thevenin resistance seen from the capacitor port, short-circuit the 10 V ideal voltage source; at this time both 3 Ω and 2 Ω are connected from the capacitor upper-end node to the bottom node, so R_th=3 Ω || 2 Ω=(3×2)/(3+2)=6/5 Ω. The capacitor C=5/6 F, therefore the time constant τ=R_th C=(6/5)(5/6)=1 s. Thus v_c(t)=V_th+(v_c(0)-V_th)e^{-t/τ}=4(1-e^{-t}). At t=1 s, v_c(1)=4(1-e^{-1})≈2.53 V, approximated according to the problem standard as 2.5 V.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the capacitor connected from the output node to ground in parallel with the 2 Ω resistor, after a 3 Ω feed resistor from a 10 V source through the switch. method.method_draft: After describing the image topology, use the text condition that SW closes at t=0 and v_c(0)=0. Let v(t)=v_c(t). Write KCL at the top node: current entering from the 10 V source through 3 Ω equals the resistor current through 2 Ω plus capacitor current, so (10-v)/3 = v/2 + (5/6) dv/dt. Rearrange to dv/dt + v = 4, using the given C=5/6 F. Solve with v(0)=0 to get v(t)=4(1-e^{-t}). At t=1 s, v_c(1)=4(1-e^{-1})≈2.53 V, which rounds to the standard answer 2.5 V.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：电路左侧是一个 10 V 直流电压源，源的上端通过开关 SW 接到上方支路；开关标注在 t=0 闭合。开关闭合后，电源经一个 3 Ω 电阻连接到右侧顶部节点。该顶部节点向下有一个 2 Ω 电阻接到底部公共节点；同一顶部节点还连接到右侧电容的上端，电容值标为 5/6 F，电容下端接到底部公共节点。电容电压 v_c(t) 标在电容两端，上端为正、下端为负。

推理：令顶部节点电压为 v(t)=v_c(t)。零初始条件给出 v(0)=0。开关闭合后，对顶部节点列 KCL：从 10 V 电源经 3 Ω 电阻流入节点的电流等于流过 2 Ω 电阻的电流加上电容电流，即 (10-v)/3 = v/2 + (5/6) dv/dt。两边乘以 6 得 20-2v=3v+5 dv/dt，因此 5 dv/dt+5v=20，即 dv/dt+v=4。解一阶微分方程并代入 v(0)=0，得到 v(t)=4(1-e^{-t})。在 t=1 s 时，v_c(1)=4(1-e^{-1})≈2.53 V，按题目标准答案取约为 2.5 V。
